What Matson says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: Ocean Transportation operating incomeBased on the outlook trends noted above, the Company expects Ocean Transportation operating income in the fourth quarter 2026 to be approximately 50 percent higher than the $136.0 million achieved in the fourth quarter 2025.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: consolidated operating incomeFor the fourth quarter 2026, the Company expects consolidated operating income to be approximately 50 percent higher than the $143.7 million achieved in the fourth quarter 2025.
  • Full year 2026: depreciation and amortizationFor full year 2026, the Company expects depreciation and amortization expense to be approximately $205 million, inclusive of dry-docking amortization of approximately $35 million.
  • Full year 2026: interest incomeThe Company expects interest income for the full year 2026 to be approximately $20 million.
